summary: American Express Co. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the issuance of $1.75 billion aggregate principal amount of 4.444% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Notes due May 3, 2030. The notes were issued on May 4, 2026, pursuant to a prospectus supplement dated April 27, 2026, under a shelf registration statement on Form S-3. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. No change of control, strategic event, or extraordinary corporate action is involved. The filing merely documents the closing and terms of the notes issuance, with no impact on equity or special-situation classification.
